provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.06:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is invisible here, 1.00:1 vs inactive selection 1.14:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.default: spec: body text = base00 on base3
provenance.fg.on-accent: choice: Solarized accents are mid-luminance; base03 gives the highest ratio on them in both modes
provenance.fg.title: spec: base01 = emphasized content (inverted)
provenance.accent.primary: choice: Solarized identity hue; no accent reaches 4.5:1 in light mode
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: distinct from blue and from info cyan
provenance.status.error: choice: accent red (README defines no UI roles)

notes: Terminal slots: solarized/xresources (identical ANSI assignment to dark): 8 = base03 (darkest, not faint), 10-12/14 = monotones.
Body text base00 on base3 is 4.13:1 (spec pairing) and fails 4.5:1; no same-role tone passes. No accent reaches 4.5:1 on base3.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): accent.secondary -> '13' (slot 5 #d33682 is not the #6c71c4 hue; slot 13 = #6c71c4, 4.06:1) | mark -> '13' (slot 5 #d33682 is not the #6c71c4 hue; slot 13 = #6c71c4, 4.06:1) | fg.muted -> 'default' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.01:1; now 4.13:1) | keyhint.desc -> '8 dim' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.01:1; now 3.57:1) | tab.inactive.fg -> '8 dim' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.01:1; now 3.57:1) | fg.on-accent -> '8' (min ratio on accent/status fills 2.93 -> 3.25)
